# Terminal markup reference

Fluent extensions declared by the `Aprillz.MewUI.Terminal` package.

### TerminalView

Receiver: `TerminalView`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `ColorScheme(TerminalColorScheme value)` | `ColorScheme` | Sets the colors; the default is Campbell. |
| `Connection(ITerminalConnection value)` | `Connection` | Sets the connection whose output this terminal shows; the terminal does not start or dispose it. |
| `CursorShape(TerminalCursorShape value)` | `CursorShape` | Sets the cursor shape shown until the application chooses one; the default is Bar. |
| `InitialColumns(int value)` | `InitialColumns` | Sets the columns the terminal asks for when it is measured. |
| `InitialRows(int value)` | `InitialRows` | Sets the rows the terminal asks for when it is measured. |
| `OnBell(Action handler)` | `event Bell` | Subscribes handler to Bell. Occurs when the application rings the bell. |
| `OnConnectionClosed(Action<int> handler)` | `event ConnectionClosed` | Subscribes handler to ConnectionClosed. Occurs when the connection ends, with its exit code or -1. |
| `OnHyperlinkActivated(Action<string> handler)` | `event HyperlinkActivated` | Subscribes handler to HyperlinkActivated. Occurs when the user Ctrl+clicks a hyperlink, with its URI. |
| `OnTitleChanged(Action<string> handler)` | `event TitleChanged` | Subscribes handler to TitleChanged. Occurs when the application sets a title, with the new title. |
| `OptionIsMeta(bool value = true)` | `OptionIsMeta` | Sets whether Option (Alt) with a key that types a character, such as Option+O typing ø on a Mac, sends ESC and the key's base character (Meta) instead of the character; the default is false. |
| `ScrollbackLines(int value)` | `ScrollbackLines` | Sets the number of rows of output kept above the screen; the default is 9001. |
| `TextPadding(double value)` | `TextPadding` | Sets the space between the edge and the cells, in DIPs; the default is 4. |
